title: Invertibility of the canonical affine module tensor comparisons
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be an affine morphism of schemes [pqf-def-affine-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Write $\mathcal A=f_*\mathcal O_U$, let $\rho:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal A$ be the structure map, and let $r_0:f^{-1}\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_U$, $t_0=f^{-1}\rho$, and $e:f^{-1}\mathcal A\to\mathcal O_U$ be the structure map, inverse-image map, and ring inverse-image/direct-image counit. Write $R$ for pushforward as an $\mathcal A$-module, and $S$ for restriction to $\mathcal O_X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Tensor pullback and change of rings are those of [def-pc-module-pullback, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], and the adjunction is the canonical one of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $B$ be a commutative ring sheaf on $U$, $b:\mathcal O_U\to B$, $t:f^{-1}\mathcal A\to B$, and $\epsilon:B\to\mathcal O_U$. Let $P:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal A)\to\operatorname{Mod}(B)$ and $H:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal A)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_U)$ be functors, let $\kappa:P\operatorname{res}_b\simeq Sf^*$, $\gamma:Sf^*\to H$, $\alpha:RH\to1$, and $\beta:1\to HR$ be natural maps. Suppose $B,b,t,\epsilon,P,\kappa,H,\gamma,\alpha,\beta$ satisfy the pushout, counit, change-of-rings object and map formulas, the formula for $\kappa$ on pullback units, the formula $\gamma(p)=1\otimes p$, preservation of quasi-coherence by $H$, and the equations $\gamma_{RF}\alpha_F=\mathrm{counit}_F$ and $S\beta_G=\mathrm{adjoint}(\gamma_G)$. Then $\alpha_F$ is an isomorphism for every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-module $F$, and $\beta_G$ is an isomorphism of $\mathcal A$-modules for every quasi-coherent $\mathcal A$-module $G$ [pqf-def-coherent].

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01SB (lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), last two paragraphs and key algebra observation

proof.text: Apply the affine unit section-bijectivity calculation to every affine open V of X. Forget beta_G to its abelian sheaf map, use Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis on the affine basis, and reflect its isomorphism to A-modules. This proves beta_G invertible for every quasi-coherent G.

The structure algebra A is quasi-coherent: affine morphisms are qcqs and the structure module is the quasi-coherent unit. For quasi-coherent F on U, f_*F is quasi-coherent over O_X; scalar restriction then implies RF is quasi-coherent over A. The hypothesis hH gives quasi-coherence of H(RF).

Applying S to beta_RF followed by R(alpha_F), the comparison equations identify it with homEquiv(gamma_RF) followed by f_*(alpha_F). Naturality of homEquiv turns this into homEquiv(gamma_RF alpha_F)=homEquiv(counit_F)=id. Scalar restriction is faithful (the maps are unchanged on underlying sections), so beta_RF R(alpha_F)=id. Since beta_RF is invertible by step 1, R(alpha_F) is invertible.

The affine opens V of X cover X, so their inverse images W cover U and are affine. Evaluation of the invertible R(alpha_F) on V is the section map of alpha_F on W, hence bijective. Both modules are quasi-coherent by step 2 and the hypothesis on F. Apply affine-cover detection to alpha_F. This proves the counit comparison without a separate affine counit tensor calculation.

proof_origin.place: Affine unit calculation retained; counit deduced by homEquiv naturality and homEquiv(counit)=id, then affine-cover detection

theorem affine_module_tensor_comparison_isIso [IsAffineHom f]
     (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u})
      (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B) (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf)
    (hring : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t ∧ b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf ∧ t ≫ ε = e₀)
     (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
        (pobj : ∀ G, P.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t (I G))
        (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f)
    (hP : (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
          P.map a = eqToHom (pobj G) ≫
            SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} t (I G)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap f.base A G a) ≫
            eqToHom (pobj G').symm) ∧
        (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (g : G.val.obj V),
          ((eqToHom (pobj G)).val.app (fV V))
            ((κ.inv.app G).val.app (fV V)
              (((adj₀).unit.app ((S).obj G)).val.app V g)) =
            ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t (I G))).app
                (fV V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj (fV V)) ⊗ₜ[(IA).obj.obj (fV V),(t.hom.app (fV V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (𝓙 X) (𝓙 U)).unit.app
                      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj G)).hom.app V g))))
     (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ U.Modules)
          (hobj : ∀ G, H.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))
          (γ : S ⋙ tensorPullback f ⟶ H)
    (hH : (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
            H.map a = eqToHom (hobj G) ≫
              SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G) (P.map a) ≫
              eqToHom (hobj G').symm) ∧
          (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (W : (Opens U)ᵒᵖ)
              (p : (P.obj G).val.obj W),
            ((eqToHom (hobj G)).val.app W)
              ((γ.app G).val.app W ((κ.hom.app G).val.app W p)) =
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 U.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app
                (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))).app W
                  ((1 : U.sheaf.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W,(ε.hom.app W).hom] p)) ∧
          (∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A),
            G.IsQuasicoherent → (H.obj G).IsQuasicoherent))
     (α : R ⋙ H ⟶ 𝟭 U.Modules) (β : 𝟭 (SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) ⟶ H ⋙ R)
    (hcomp : (∀ F : U.Modules, γ.app ((R).obj F) ≫ α.app F = (adj₀).counit.app F) ∧
            (∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A),
              (S).map (β.app G) = ((adj₀).homEquiv ((S).obj G) (H.obj G)) (γ.app G))) :
(∀ F : U.Modules, F.IsQuasicoherent → IsIso (α.app F)) ∧
            (∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A), G.IsQuasicoherent → IsIso (β.app G))
